[b][New contents][/b]
-‌Another new map this month: [b]SUBWAY IN OLD WORLD - SUBWAY DISPATCH STATION[/b]
●‌A former subway dispatch station in the suburbs of New York City, which is surrounded by the city buildings now. The old New York City left this monumental building as a memento of the year AD.
●‌This map is the largest one so far. Because of its open space, Watcher will be seen easier. On the other hand, the sparse terrain is also a test for player's operation of Extractor.
‌
[b]‌[Experience optimization][/b]
‌-‌Some side/tail panels of the "Flying Trucks" were forced to close by the East Tales Corperation. Extractors will have no chance to jump into any strange places from "Flying Trucks".
‌
[b]‌[Audio][/b]
‌-Now the Extractors will groan continuously when they are injured in a game.
‌
[b]‌[Bug fixed][/b]
‌-Fixed some display issues of mission system and character upgrade system.
‌-Fixed some Russian localization issues.

notes.title: Update Note 11.07
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=mdKzlrbbUHk;full][/previewyoutube]
Hi, if you have some opinions for the game, please join in our Discord channel and discuss with devs or other players: [url=https://discord.gg/SbtYM3x]https://discord.gg/SbtYM3x[/url]

[b][New contents][/b]
-New Watcher -- "Scarecrow"Richard has come! He is a terror hunter who hunts innocent people in the shadowy world underground New York. He will use his malicious toxic trap to catch everything he wants to hunt!

●Initiative skill: Mr. Scarecrow's cocktail
Set a poison gas trap, which can be triggered by walking/running Extractor, and will damage Extractor constantly for a certain time (Extractors can deactivate traps when squat down into the range of traps). State of poisoning which is caused by Scarecrow can be healed by treatment at once.
●Passive skill: Malicious protocol
The normal attack from Scarecrow attaches highly toxic substance, and will damages "prey" constantly for a certain time. State of poisoning which is caused by Scarecrow can be healed by treatment at once. In the meantime, Scarecrow has the crouch ability which is from the East Tales Corporation.
●Shareable skill: Scarecrow's Requiem
When an Extractor is knocked down, his aura will be revealed continuously, all other Extractors' auras will be revealed for 6 s.

-Added new in-game new player guide. New player will see the detailed game guide in a match until Lv.15, it will help new player get familiar with the game faster. Before Lv.15, if you don't like the guide, you can close it in options.

[b][Optimization][/b]
-Optimized the map SUBWAY IN OLD WORLD - MID TOWN SQUARE for FPS.

[b][Balance][/b]
-Added Dynamic Balance system, to slightly balance the cases which are teaming and big level difference between two sides.We will continue to observe how the new system works and possibly make continuous adjustments.
-The skill changes:
●"Calm" - Geisha
Boost the recovery rate of Energy Charges by 70%.→85%.
●"Little Present" - Fortress
The damage of bomb is increased by 30%. The change does not affect the bounce damage.

[b][Bug fixed][/b]
-Fixed a spot that Extractor can reach but Wacter can't in the map SUBWAY IN OLD WORLD - MID TOWN SQUARE.
-Tried to fix the issue that all remaining Data Cubes may disappear in the midway of a match in the maps SUBWAY IN OLD WORLD - MID TOWN SQUARE and HANGING GARDENS - TAI-CHI.

notes.title: Update Note 10.25
Update Note 10.18
Update Note 10.17
notes.notes:
Hi, 
Here is a new update for the game! If you have some opinions for the game , please join in our Discord channel and discuss with devs or other players: [url=https://discord.gg/SbtYM3x]https://discord.gg/SbtYM3x[/url]

1. Added matchmaking queue number display, it will help players judge the cases of the queue and choose the role which can enter the game quicker.

2. Voice system update: Player can see a horn icon when all players chat by microphone, and players also can close own voice if don’t want to hear.

3. All Extractor can’t use initiative skills on “Flying Truck” now, they are tired for the match and need to have a rest.

4. The time length of “Flying Trucks are coming” is increased to 20 seconds, added the tips of “Flying Trucks” ’ locations.

5. added more tips about Extractors’ behaviors, Extractors can receive more info of current match and judge the situation.

6. Show the game account level when players choose characters, instead of character level.

7. Changed the terrain which can be abused of HANGING GARDENS - OPERATIC GARDEN, TAI-CHI, SALT SHAKER PRISON - FACTORY AREA.

8. If someone quit previous match midway abnormally, he will get a cooldown of matchmaking. The more quit, the more cooldown. We understand the anger about the game, but we also don't support rage quit. If someone who has the cooldown in a team, the whole team can’t do matchmaking.

9. Reduced the time to heal Extractor who is in digital form.

10. All machines (Data Miner & Data Warehouse) will be locked when Extractors enter the Arena, and will be implanted virus randomly. Because Watchers are the master of the Arena, Extractors should restrain themselves.

11. The number of normal attacks required by Watcher to knock down a completely healthy Extractor is reduced by 1 (except Crow), and the total number of normal attacks required by the Watcher to eliminate an Extractor is reduced by 1, the attack range is adjusted in the meantime, which is the dignity of countless angry Watcher in background data.

notes.title: Update Note (10.13)
notes.notes:
Hi, if you have some opinions for the game ,please join in our Discord channel and discuss with devs or other players: [url=https://discord.gg/SbtYM3x]https://discord.gg/SbtYM3x[/url]

[b][Audio][/b]
●Add new in-game voice system (testing function), bring better game experience to players. If you dislike this, please turn off this in VOICE option directly (it will be opened in default). Players also can close someone player’s voice in a match, just open the VOICE option and click the player who you don’t want to hear;
Attention: It’s a testing function, maybe you will hear other players with low or intermittent voice for the issue of microphone voice reception. We will try to fix this issue after an update of game engine.
●Add new music for taking “Flying Truck” and the game result/stats after a match.

[b][Matchmaking][/b]
●+20% Exp. for players who use RANDOM MATCH (same with custom game).

[b][UI][/b]
●Add a tip for current matchmaking role queue.

[b][Gameplay][/b]
●The moving speed of Extractor digital form changed to the highest speed of normal speed of Watcher;
●The Energy Charges will be full when both sides enter a match, the game will be more nervous;
●Fixed some terrain design which can be abused.
To avoid zero-sum game, the walls/obstacles which are built by Watcher will be locked for 7 s, and Watcher can remove locked walls/obstacles directly;
●Now we transfer some damage from execution to normal attack.
